x: Gary McGURREN, Glynn Tiernan and Matthew Kinane have been mainly responsible for this effort, finishing each race with barely a vest between them all season.

The most significant team result was stealing a highly contested Surrey Championship title with a fine individual 4th from Garry McGurren, backed by Matthew Kinane (flying in from Switzerland hours before), Simon Beaumont and Glynn Tiernan.
Dave Swain became our 4th fastest ever 1500m runner with a 3.40.95 at the Rome Grand Prix while Glynn Tiernan was runner up in the Surrey Juniors.
